en.answer: <<13228>> will be a face-up "Altergeist" card on your field when activating its effect, so you can target it as the card on the field to send to the Graveyard.
en.question: When activating the effect of <<13228>> that sends an "Altergeist" card on my field to the Graveyard and Special Summons an "Altergeist" monster from the Graveyard, can that <<13228>> on the field be targeted?
